findings.problem: Two defects in one string. (a) Fit: 296.2 pt at the tip's 12 pt meta step against the ~288 pt one-line row at 320 pt, and the row is numberOfLines={1} at 100 % text scale, so the tail is ellipsized; English's own longest tip is 267.7 pt. (b) Meaning: «для субагентов» reads as work *for* the subagents' benefit, while the source's “fan out subagents” makes the subagents the mechanism the work spreads into — the relation is reversed.

findings.current: поставьте расписание запуска промпта по таймеру
findings.problem: Fit: 313.8 pt against the same ~288 pt one-line row at 320 pt — the widest entry in the pool and 46 pt over the row, so it truncates at 100 % text scale. Wording: «поставьте расписание» is not the Russian collocation for setting a schedule (it is задают or настраивают); «поставить» belongs with a task (поставить задачу) or a timer, not a schedule.

findings.current: поищите прошлые беседы, чтобы открыть сессию
findings.problem: Fit: 306.0 pt against the ~288 pt row at 320 pt, so it truncates at 100 %. Wording: «поищите прошлые беседы» searches *for* past conversations; the source searches *in* them to reopen a session, and the missing «в» turns the scope into the object.

considered_and_accepted.reason: The 24-character figure is an English-calibrated character budget, not this slot's constraint: the chip row is measured in points and the code keeps a per-locale SUGGESTION_CHAR_BUDGET for exactly that reason. Measured, this chip is 196.8 pt against the ~254 pt text box at 320 pt (Spanish's widest, which the code records as 189.4 pt, fits at the same box), so it does not truncate and even at 200 % text scale it wraps to the second line the row allows at large text. The wave must raise the budget when it ships (see ship_gate below), not shorten the copy.

considered_and_accepted.judgement: ACCEPT — a verb divergence from core that is not a glossary violation.
considered_and_accepted.reason: Core's committed Russian uses «пробудить» once, in wire.settings.team_bridge_session.help («Сессия, которую можно пробудить при новых сообщениях»), while this chip uses «Разбудите меня». The glossary's term is the noun «пробуждение»; the glossary says a preferred rendering is a citation form, and that a row is violated by a different TERM, not by a grammar form. «Разбудить» is the everyday verb for waking a person and is the only natural imperative for this playful chip; «Пробудите меня со сводкой» would read literary. No change requested.

ship_gate: mobile.home.tip.* replacements must land before the ru set is flipped to shipped.

Before the flip, SUGGESTION_CHAR_BUDGET and IDENTICAL_BY_DESIGN are Record<ShippedLocale, …>: adding ru without entries is a TypeScript error. The widest ru chip measures 26 characters (phone_access), and the identity list needs mobile.schedules.head.overdue (the only value in the wave byte-identical to English).

At this head src/i18n/__tests__/catalogues.test.ts fails on the directory↔SHIPPED_LOCALES binding (expected: the directory exists before the ship flip), so the branch cannot be green until the flip lands.
notes: Proof that this namespace has no plural node and no placeholder, derived rather than assumed: verify.mjs reports 0 plural nodes and identical (empty) parameter lists for all 27 keys.
Composition evidence for a manager request about mobile.schedules keys (group B) is attached as appendix-composition.txt; it carries no verdict on this namespace.

route.engine: the repository's own renderer: messages.parseMessage + messages.formatMessage + messages.pluralCategory (the same functions renderFor calls)
route.render_entry_point: renderFor(key, args, "ru") returns the ENGLISH source at this head, because ru is still in NOT_YET_SHIPPED_LOCALES (proved in audit.log of ru30a1 via appendix-composition.txt); every ru string in these records was therefore rendered by calling formatMessage(parseMessage(<ru value>), args, "ru") directly, which is byte-identically what renderFor does once ru ships — proved by rendering all 38 zh-CN mobile.schedules keys through both paths and getting identical output.
route.width_engine: swift + CoreText over the app's sans stack (measure.swift.txt); Figtree absent on this machine, so widths use the system face — the harness reproduces the repo's recorded 189.4 pt Spanish chip measurement, which is why ratios are used for judgement
route.machine_translation: none — no translation or MT service was used to compare or back-translate
route.read_only: the working tree was not edited, staged, committed or pushed; the only writes are these audit bundles under i18n/audits/evidence/ru/

ledger.note: No audit-ledger command and no i18n ledger exist in this repository at this head (i18n/ holds only audits/, and scripts/i18n/ has check-strings, generate, key-shape, ratchet, scan-strings — no ledger writer). The served record is this record.json under i18n/audits/evidence/<locale>/<namespace>/<id>/, matching the fr, es and zh-CN waves' machinery. There is likewise no i18n/audits/evidence/README.md contract in this checkout.

audit_notes_not_execution_log: This record and report.md are NOTES. The execution evidence is audit.log in the same directory: a bash set -x transcript of the catalogue validator, verify.mjs for this namespace, and verify.mjs --negative, captured when they ran. widths.tsv / tip-overflow.txt / widths-placeholder.tsv / appendix-composition.txt are measurement and composition artifacts, produced by the harnesses also stored here.
evidence_limitations: Figtree is not installed on this machine, so CoreText widths use the system sans face; absolute points are approximate and the report leans on ratios and on the headroom each row records. The harness reproduces the repository's own recorded 189.4 pt Spanish-chip measurement, which is the calibration check.

renderFor(key, args, "ru") cannot render this catalogue yet — ru is still in NOT_YET_SHIPPED_LOCALES — so renders come from formatMessage(parseMessage(<ru value>), args, "ru"), proved byte-equal to renderFor on the 38 zh-CN mobile.schedules keys.
No rendered frame was captured: this was a copy audit, and the app was not built or driven. A UI reviewer still has to look at the ru strings in a build.

The 320 pt field width for ended_placeholder is derived from the sidecar's own 390 pt measurement (~348 pt) minus the viewport difference; it is an inference from a recorded measurement, not a direct capture.

Plural and placeholder machinery was exercised on the whole ru catalogue (11 plural nodes, all carrying one/few/many/other with correct numeral-noun agreement) but this namespace contains none of them.
